sources.snippet: The Workplace Safety Monitor is designed to enhance workplace safety by automatically detecting people and their required safety equipment (helmets and safety vests) in video streams. The system uses state-of-the-art computer vision techniques to provide accurate, real-time monitoring with minimal false positives.
